mapper.sql: id, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version, is_deleted, code, source_id, source_code, source_type, delivery_qty, warehouse_id, warehouse_name
mapper.select: SELECT pt.id, ptd.sku_id, ptd.sku_no, ptd.fn_sku, SUM(ptd.delivery_qty) AS deliveryQty FROM packing_task_detail ptd LEFT JOIN packing_task pt ON pt.id = ptd.main_id AND pt.is_deleted=FALSE WHERE ptd.is_deleted=FALSE AND ptd.main_id = #{mainId} GROUP BY pt.id, ptd.sku_id, ptd.sku_no, ptd.fn_sku

SELECT pt.id, ptd.sku_id, ptd.sku_no, SUM(ptd.delivery_qty) AS deliveryQty FROM packing_task_detail ptd LEFT JOIN packing_task pt ON pt.id = ptd.main_id AND pt.is_deleted=FALSE WHERE ptd.is_deleted=FALSE
AND ptd.main_id in
#{item}
GROUP BY pt.id, ptd.sku_id, ptd.sku_no

SELECT wc.id as taskId, wc.source_id as sourceId, -- wc.source_type as sourceType, wc.box_spec_no as boxSpecNo, wc.package_weight as packageWeight, wc.box_length as boxLength, wc.box_width as boxWidth, wc.box_height as boxHeight, wc.box_qty as boxQty, wcb.box_no as boxNo, wcd.sku_id as skuId, wcd.sku_no as skuNo, wcd.pack_qty as packQty, wc.create_time as createTime, wc.update_time as updateTime, wc.create_user_id as createUserId, wc.create_user_name as createUserName, wc.update_user_id as updateUserId, wc.update_user_name as updateUserName, wcd.update_user_id as packingUserId, wcd.update_user_name as packingUserName FROM wms_carton_copy1 wc LEFT JOIN wms_carton_bill_copy1 wcb on wcb.carton_id = wc.id and wcb.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN wms_carton_detail_copy1 wcd on wcd.carton_id = wc.id and wcd.is_deleted = FALSE where wc.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY taskId

SELECT ptd.main_id AS taskId, COUNT ( DISTINCT ptd.sku_id ) AS productNum FROM packing_task_detail ptd WHERE ptd.is_deleted = FALSE
AND ptd.main_id IN
#{id}
GROUP BY ptd.main_id

select taskId,sourceId,sourceCode from ( select pt.id as taskId, pt.source_id as sourceId, pt.source_code as sourceCode from packing_task pt where pt.is_deleted = false
and pt.source_code ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%')
order by case when pt.source_code ILIKE concat(#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') THEN 1 when pt.source_code ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text) THEN 2 when pt.source_code ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') THEN 3 end
) pt2

select wc.id as cartonId, wc.box_no, wcs.id as specId, wcs.box_spec_no, wcs.package_weight, wcs.box_length, wcs.box_width, wcs.box_height, wcs.weight_unit, wcs.size_unit from wms_carton_spec wcs left join wms_carton wc on wc.spec_id = wcs.id and wc.is_deleted = false where wcs.is_deleted =false
and wcs.main_id = #{taskId}
